prompt: Round 2 of 6. The company side proposes (Contract research fits a bounded industrial troubleshooting problem with a clear target outcome. We want company owners

content.text:
The company proposes contract_research_company_owns. My hard limit is university ownership. I need to push back on IP. I'll accept most terms but change ip to uni_owns_option_to_licence (or company_owns_uni_academic_use since this is contract research and the findings will be embedded in their production process). 

Actually, my position card says university ownership of results is my interest. But contract_research_company_owns is a standard Lambert model for contract research. My card says I want university ownership. Let me counter with company_owns_uni_academic_use as a compromise - company owns but university keeps academic use rights, which allows publication.

Also publication: 60 days review is acceptable (not exceeding 90). companyMayRemoveConfidential: true is fine as long as results aren't removed.
I'll settle on two changes: switch ip to company_owns_uni_academic_use as my compromise, and tighten publication reviewDays down to 30 to match my preferred terms.
